mapper.sql: C.CPN_ID, C.CPN_NM, C.CPN_TYPE, C.DC_VAL, C.MAX_DC_AMT, C.MIN_ORD_AMT, C.VALID_DAYS, C.ISSUE_LMT_CNT, C.ISSUE_CNT, C.ISSUE_STRT_DT, C.ISSUE_END_DT, C.USE_YN, C.RMK, TO_CHAR(C.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REG_DT, C.REG_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CPN ( CPN_ID, CPN_NM, CPN_TYPE, DC_VAL, MAX_DC_AMT, MIN_ORD_AMT, VALID_DAYS, ISSUE_LMT_CNT, ISSUE_CNT, ISSUE_STRT_DT, ISSUE_END_DT, USE_YN, RMK, REG_DT, REG_ID) VALUES ( #{CPN_ID}, #{CPN_NM}, #{CPN_TYPE}, #{DC_VAL}, #{MAX_DC_AMT}, NVL(#{MIN_ORD_AMT}, 0), #{VALID_DAYS}, NVL(#{ISSUE_LMT_CNT}, 0), 0, #{ISSUE_STRT_DT}, #{ISSUE_END_DT}, NVL(#{USE_YN}, 'Y'), #{RMK}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CPN SET USE_YN = 'N', UPD_DT = SYSDATE, UPD_ID = #{USER_ID} WHERE CPN_ID = #{CPN_ID}
UPDATE TB_CPN SET ISSUE_CNT = ISSUE_CNT + 1, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE CPN_ID = #{cpnId}
mapper.select: SELECT I.ISSUE_NO, I.CPN_ID, I.MBR_ID, I.ISSUE_DT, I.EXP_DT, I.USE_YN, I.ORD_NO, I.DC_AMT, C.CPN_NM, C.CPN_TYPE, C.DC_VAL, C.MAX_DC_AMT, C.MIN_ORD_AMT FROM TB_CPN_ISSUE I JOIN TB_CPN C ON C.CPN_ID = I.CPN_ID WHERE I.ISSUE_NO = #{issueNo}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_CPN_ISSUE WHERE CPN_ID = #{CPN_ID} AND MBR_ID = #{MBR_ID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CPN_ISSUE (ISSUE_NO, CPN_ID, MBR_ID, ISSUE_DT, EXP_DT, USE_YN, DC_AMT, ISSUE_TYPE, REG_DT, REG_ID) VALUES (#{ISSUE_NO}, #{CPN_ID}, #{MBR_ID}, #{ISSUE_DT}, #{EXP_DT}, 'N', 0, 'MANUAL', SYSDATE, #{REG_ID})
mapper.select: SELECT ISSUE_NO, CPN_ID, DC_AMT, EXP_DT FROM TB_CPN_ISSUE WHERE ORD_NO = #{ordNo} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1
